board: Maine Board of Accountancy (Office of Professional and Occupational Regulation)

cycle.note: Maine licenses renew every September 30. Each license year (October 1 – September 30) needs 40 hours, and up to 20 extra carry into the next year. 4 hours of ethics every three years.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: 40 hours each license year (Ch. 5 §8(A)). Up to 20 hours over the 40 carry into the next license year only.

requirements.label: Limited subjects
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than half (20 hours) from communication arts, mathematics and statistics, economics, business law, personnel and software applications (Ch. 5 §9(C)(4)(b)).
requirements.otherLabel: Accounting, auditing, tax, ethics, management services or industry topics

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 4 hours of ethics every three years: Maine accountancy laws and rules, or the AICPA or SEC conduct standards (Ch. 5 §8(B)).

newLicensee.note: No CPE is due for the license year your license was first issued in; your first 40 hours are due at the end of the first full license year.

issueDateHint: If your license was first issued this license year (since October 1), no CPE is due for it.
limitsNotTracked: Instructor credit: 3× class time for the first presentation only, max 50%.
CPA exam review courses and committee service don't count.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for the three license years before the current one (Ch. 5 §8(D)).
toVerify: Ethics: modelled as 4 hours in the current and two previous license years (the rule counts three years from your first renewal).
Limited subjects: Personal Development and Business Management assumed to fall in the 50% group.
Carried-forward hours also count toward the 50% limit (state CPA society) — not modelled.
